# Installer bulletin - event F-07 on SH-3K and SH-5K strings

Issued 2026-07-30. Event F-07 is a DC ground fault. The inverter latches out until the string insulation is tested with a megohmmeter and the wet connector is replaced; re-energise only after the readings are clean.

turns.prompt: A Sunhollow SH-5K on the depot roof latched out with event F-07 on the display. What does the installer bulletin say F-07 is, and what does it ask for? Answer in a sentence or two.
